name: Weeden Foundation biodiversity grants
summary: Grants of usually $20,000-$25,000 to 501(c)(3) organisations or their international equivalents for biodiversity conservation, including habitat protection, wildlife corridors and stewardship involving Indigenous peoples; applicants first submit a letter of inquiry in set monthly windows.

calls.label: Letter of inquiry windows (March, July, November)
calls.recurring: Letters of inquiry are accepted in March, July and November each year (the 1st to the last day of each month).

status.quote: LOI submission periods March 1-31 July 1-31 November 1-30

recurring.quote: LOI submission periods March 1-31 July 1-31 November 1-30

applicant_types.quote: We only fund 501 (c)(3) organizations or its international equivalent.

access.quote: After clearing eligibility you may submit a Letter of Inquiry (LOI).

window.quote: LOI submission periods March 1-31 July 1-31 November 1-30

amount.quote: Our grants are usually in the $20,000 - $25,000 range.

geography.quote: We support biodiversity conservation projects mainly located in Africa and Latin America.
